title: Split Array into Consecutive Subsequences
description: Determine if the array can be split into consecutive subsequences of length at least 3.
pseudocode:
1. count = map frequency of all elements
2. tails = map of count of consecutive sequences ending at x
3. for x in nums:
4.   if count[x] == 0: continue
5.   if tails[x-1] > 0: decrement tails[x-1], increment tails[x]
6.   else if count[x+1] > 0 and count[x+2] > 0: decrement count[x+1], count[x+2], increment tails[x+2]
7.   else: return false
8. return true

steps.note: 1 cannot extend a subsequence, starts a new one: decrement counts of 2 and 3
